module TopModule(
    input  logic in,
    input  logic [1:0] state,
    output logic [1:0] next_state,
    output logic out
);

    always_comb
    begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // State A
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // A -> B (in=1), A -> A (in=0)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b01: begin // State B
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // B -> B (in=1), B -> C (in=0)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b10: begin // State C
                next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // C -> D (in=1), C -> A (in=0)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b11: begin // State D
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // D -> B (in=1), D -> C (in=0)
                out        = 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = 2'b00;
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  in,
    output out
);

    reg state; // 1'b0 = state A, 1'b1 = state B

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset)
            state <= 1'b1; // asynchronous reset to state B
        else
            state <= (state & in) | (~state & ~in); // next-state logic
    end

    assign out = state; // Moore output: 1 in state B, 0 in state A

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output reg [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            // Synchronous load: transfer data to q
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            // Shift operations selected by 'amount'
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= q << 1;           // Shift left by 1 bit (logical zero-fill)
                2'b01: q <= q << 8;           // Shift left by 8 bits (logical zero-fill)
                2'b10: q <= {q[63], q[63:1]}; // Arithmetic right shift by 1 bit (sign-extend MSB)
                2'b11: q <= { {8{q[63]}}, q[63:8] }; // Arithmetic right shift by 8 bits (sign-extend top 8 bits)
                default: q <= q;              // Default case (hold)
            endcase
        end
        // If ~load and ~ena, q retains its previous value (hold state)
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            q <= 4'b0001;          // synchronous reset to 1
        else if (q == 4'b1010)    // when count reaches 10 (binary 1010)
            q <= 4'b0001;         // wrap around to 1
        else
            q <= q + 1'b1;        // normal increment
    end

endmodule
